front: When did North Korea invade South Korea?
When and where was the Korean armistice signed?

back: An agreement to stop fighting that is not a peace treaty.
Pushing communism back out of a country it already ruled, as the UN tried in North Korea in October 1950.
MacArthur's landing behind North Korean lines on 15 September 1950, which turned the war.

front: Why could the UN act in Korea in 1950?
back: The USSR was boycotting the Security Council over China's seat, so it could not use its veto.

front: Why did China enter the Korean War?
back: UN forces crossed the 38th parallel and advanced towards the Yalu River, China's border.
MacArthur publicly called for war on China and hinted at atomic weapons; Truman wanted a limited war.

front: Was containment in Korea a success?
back: Containment yes (South Korea survived); rollback no (North Korea stayed communist); very high cost.
